lesson.detail: Pull request #685 changed implement.yml's workflow-level env. AGENT_MODEL_FALLBACK now defaults to claude-opus-5-5 where the variable is unset (decision A683a). A second model that is the same as the first counts as none (A683b). The facts list no changed_steps, because the change is to the `env:` block and not to a named step, so no step's log could be checked against it. The transcript shows Fred's session ran on claude-opus-5-5 on every turn. That matches this repository's AGENT_MODEL, which an earlier retro on the same day saw set to claude-opus-5-5. Here the second model equals the first, so A683b applies and no switch to a second model was expected. The session completed and published its change in 169 seconds for $0.63, with no API errors or retries. The run did not exercise a real switch to a second model, because no usage limit held. Neither reviewer of #685 recorded an assumption.
